A '''wooden spear''' is a [[spear]] of the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] tier, crafted from one plank and two sticks. It is the only wooden item that keeps the vanilla durability of {{Value|Wooden Spear|durability}}.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Wooden Spear|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Wooden Spear|attackspeed}} and works like the vanilla {{MCW|spear}}. The pack blocks the vanilla recipe and replaces it with its own, which adds only the tooltip.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
